title: Constructive Algebraic and Spectral-Repair Certificates for the 1/2 Logarithmic Exponent of Finite Fourier Transforms
abstract: We present FFT-EXP-HALF-CERT-1.0, an independently reproducible, zero-floating-point verification suite and constructive Lean 4.35.0 kernel auditing the finite-dimensional algebraic, geometric, nilpotent time-expansion, Hermite spectral-repair, and Bluestein chirp-specialization mechanisms of OpenAI's November 24, 2026 unrefereed preprint 'The logarithmic exponent of finite Fourier transforms' (Theorems 1.1, 1.2, 2.2, 4.1, and Corollary 8.2). Without claiming to formalize the preprint's Zariski-closure Grassmannian compactness or asymptotic recursion over arbitrary fields, we build a four-mode exact verifier over Z, Q, and F_p backed by 18 constructive Lean 4 theorems (0 sorry, 0 custom axioms, 0 Classical.choice, 0 warnings). Across 16 canonical certificates (C01-C16), we audit Lemma 2.3 two-phase controlled-addition swaps, Theorem 2.2 Pythagorean rectangle price excesses, and Proposition 2.4 force-disk midpoint rigidity, Lemma 3.3 nilpotent time-expansion rank/support decompositions of feedback linear systems and Lemma 3.2 block-echelon row quotients, Section 4.1/Lemma 4.2 integral parity-sign count predictors, Lemma 4.3 Potter/Clifford matrix linearizations L^b = pI, and Lemma 4.4 full-rate Hermite spectral repair for ell in {2,3}, and Section 5.1-5.2 Fourier query-product kernels, Hamming-distance Gram ranks over F_ell, and Corollary 8.2 Bluestein chirp convolution specialization. All 16 certificates, 70 unit/forgery tests, and 37 SHA-256 hashes verify deterministically.
